title: Recurring location language in the Copper Scroll: occurrences, readings and project dependencies

sources.text_shown: data/scroll-text.js (ETCBC dss 2.0.1; Abegg, Bowley and Cook; CC BY-NC 4.0)

hebrew_marks: letters read by the editions behind the shown text
hebrew_marks.°: after a letter: damaged, uncertain letter
hebrew_marks.< >: supplied or corrected by the modern editor
hebrew_marks.^ ^: written above the line by the scribe

link_kinds.explicit: The expression is written in the text. reading_status says whether the editions agree on the letters.
link_kinds.restored: The expression stands in a lacuna or in damaged letters and exists only in the restoration or reading of the named proposer.
link_kinds.proposed: The expression is not in the entry; an editor or the project associates the entry with its referent.

membership.certain: Shares one meaning with the other certain members of the expression.
membership.conditional: A member only under the stated reading or restoration; the strict test assigns it the same meaning, the split test does not.
membership.control: Listed for comparison (the axis is stated, or the word is cancelled); never assigned a meaning.
membership.proposed: Not in the text of the entry; listed to show which entries an editor or the project ties to the referent. Never assigned a meaning.

conventions.quotation_limit: Edition renderings are short phrases of 12 words or fewer.
